info.title: ClientBus Notification Contract
info.description: Stage 11 REST/SSE contract. Center and installation endpoints are implemented in 11.8; durable History Sync in 11.10. SSE and new history submissions are feature-flagged. Bearer token only, never URL. Private REST/SSE use Cache-Control: no-store.

200.description: SSE event equals type; data is UiEventEnvelope. No replay/id cursor. ready precedes live data; auth error before opening is HTTP.

delete.summary: Delete the current employee’s entire personal notification center

200.description: Original atomic clear result; also returned for the same Idempotency-Key.

delete.description: Deletes read and unread notifications across all workspaces, including inaccessible targets, only for the authenticated enabled recipient. One statement snapshot; Idempotency-Key retry returns the original result and preserves later arrivals. Dedup records remain until normal retention. Linked deliveries are removed; an already issued provider call cannot be recalled.

put.summary: Idempotent single read; unchanged readAt on repeat

put.description: No body. One UPDATE snapshot. Repeat key returns stored result without reading new arrivals.

ETag.description: Current quoted registrationVersion, only after valid installation proof. Use only for a fresh action in the current account session, never to replay a stale mutation.

put.description: Creation requires expectedRegistrationVersion=0 and an absent installation. Update and explicit account rebind require proof and current registrationVersion. Every mutation increments registrationVersion atomically; stale requests return 409 INSTALLATION_CONFLICT without mutation. Rebind uses the authenticated new owner. Never automatically retry an old mutation with a refreshed version.

delete.summary: Unbind own installation with proof and matching binding

post.description: 202 only after commit. Same key and parameters return original operation including terminal, within 7 days. Persist key before sending; no automatic retry after window.

get.summary: Own operation and current conversation ACL

get.description: Active-only discovery supplements idempotent POST recovery; completed operations can be absent.

200.description: Current employee preference; legacy null is enabled.

put.description: Applies to the authenticated employee across Workspaces. An effective change commits a personal notifications.invalidated event with the preference.

200.description: Current employee preference; legacy null is enabled.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client UUID persisted before request; actor/command-scoped, 7 day safe retry window.

PageCursor.name: pageCursor
PageCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to actor, organization and query.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted registrationVersion; DELETE requires current owner and proof, increments registrationVersion and disables the installation. Stale requests return 409 INSTALLATION_CONFLICT.

templateArgs.description: Technical template parameters plus REST-only current senderName, channelType and channelName when available. Presentation is resolved with current target ACL; names are not persisted in notification/outbox or sent in push.

importedCount.description: Distinct messages from the connector page successfully available in the cache; existing cached messages count once.
